title: India 🇮🇳 vs USA 🇺🇸: true or false? 3 rounds, real data
headline: India or *America*?
description: India or America: size of the economy, growth and the army. Three true-or-false rounds with real World Bank data. How many did you get right?
source: World Bank: GDP and GDP growth in current US dollars (2025), armed forces personnel (2020), data.worldbank.org

hi.title: भारत 🇮🇳 vs अमेरिका 🇺🇸: सच या झूठ? 3 राउंड
hi.description: भारत या अमेरिका: अर्थव्यवस्था, विकास और सेना। असली आंकड़े, तीन राउंड। अपना झंडा कमेंट करें।

segments.text: India or America. True or false? India's economy is half of America's.

props.statement: India's economy is half the size of America's

segments.text: False. America's is almost eight times bigger.
Round two. India's economy grows three times faster.

props.statement: India's economy grows 3x faster than America's

segments.text: True. Seven point six percent. America did two point two.
Final round. India has more soldiers than America.

props.statement: India has more soldiers than America

segments.text: True. More than twice as many.
